scenarios.name: opponent-loses-life-on-your-turn-doubled
scenarios.why: During its controller's turn, the opponent's three life lost to Lightning Bolt is doubled to six.

scenarios.name: opponent-loses-life-on-opponents-turn-normal
scenarios.why: The replacement applies only during Bloodletter controller's turn; a Bolt cast by seat 1 on its own turn deals its normal three damage.
